answer_1.quote: We also test MATCHA on chart-to-text summarization tasks and observe clear improvements over Pix2Struct and achieves SOTA on Chart-to-Text (Kantharaj et al., 2022) Pew split. ... In chart derendering, given a plot/chart, the image-to-text model is required to generate its underlying data table or the code used to render it.
answer_1.outputs: generated data tables, rendering code, answer strings, and textual summaries

answer_2.quote: For ChartQA and PlotQA, following previous works, we use relaxed correctness (exact match but tolerating 5% of numerical error). For Chart-to-Text, we use BLEU4.
